title: kithctl watch: HTTP 401 and 403 produce identical error message
description: watch.rs:292-298 prints the same message for 401 and 403. 403 means kithd recognized the caller as a peer (wrong node), not that tailscaled is down. The merged message misdirects diagnosis. Fix: 401 → 'not recognized — is tailscaled running on this node?'; 403 → 'recognized as peer, not owner — run kithctl from the same Tailscale node as kithd'.
